about.title: About the Secret Wonders set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Secret Wonders is a Diamond & Pearl expansion released on 1 November 2007. It has 132 cards: 132 in the main set and 0 secret rares. There are also 130 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 132 main set cards) or the Master set (262 cards, adding the reverse holos).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
